title: Other Health Insurance, Region Moves and Claim Filing Limits for the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
Three further terms are set per tier of the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans**: whether TRICARE pays after other health insurance, whether the plan moves with the purchaser to the gaining region on a move out of the West Region, and the claim filing limit, counted in calendar days after the date of service.

| Tier | TRICARE pays after other health insurance | Plan moves to the gaining region on a move out of the West Region | Claim must be received within (calendar days after the date of service) |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | yes | yes | 365 |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | yes | yes | 365 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | yes | yes | 365 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | yes | yes | 365 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | yes | yes | 365 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | yes | yes | 365 |

Each tier applies its own row; all six tiers carry the same three terms.
